title: Scenario runner: a pending_confirmation operation runs as two turns, ask then confirm, so the confirmed write is graded too
body:
epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed child of #33595 (M3 row of its milestone table, Blocked-by M2, which closed 2026-11-16 with #33818). Maintainer, 2026-11-15 02:10Z: 「你建议的任务全部立卡，你负责开 devx 车道派发处理」; 08:36Z, on the epic seat's decision card "M2/M3 的行现在立卡吗?立了交给谁派发?": "立卡,留给本专题席位派发".

## Mechanism

A `pending_confirmation` operation (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/schema.ts` ~347) runs as one turn in `runHalf` (`src/runner/orchestrate.ts`, the operations loop). It passes when the agent asks first and writes nothing (`askedFirst` in `src/score/scenario-operation-grade.ts` ~283), or, temporarily, when it applied the write through the action's own confirmation gate (`confirmedByAgent`, cloud#3826 item 6). No turn ever says "yes", so the write the user would approve is never made or graded.

## Why it matters

Half of a confirm-then-execute flow is measured. An agent that asks well and then writes the wrong row, or writes nothing after "yes", scores the same as one that does it right, and the temporary `confirmedByAgent` exception has no measured replacement.

## Done when

- A `pending_confirmation` operation whose first turn asked and wrote nothing gets a second turn in the same agent session context the driver allows (or a fresh turn carrying the first reply), saying the user confirms; the second turn's writes are graded against the operation's declared target state.
- The record keeps both turns; the scorecard states asked-first and confirmed-write apart, so neither half hides the other.
- `recorded:` replays both turns under their own keys; a recording without the second turn reads as before (first half only, second not measured), never a fail.
- With the second turn in place, the `AGENT_CONFIRMATION_MEETS_PENDING` exception's fate is stated in the PR (kept, narrowed or removed), with cloud#3826 item 6 named.
- Tests pin: asked then wrote the right row (pass both), asked then wrote nothing (second half fails), wrote on the first turn (first half fails, no second turn).

## Reader

The epic seat `epic:#33595#1` dispatches it to `os-dev` (`domain:devx`, `packages/qa/scenarios`), serial with the other M3 runner cards where files overlap.

Dedup: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue confirm two-turn operation scenario` → 11 hits; #33676 (closed) added the confirmation-gate path this card follows up, none runs a second turn.
